package.description: Remotely sleep, wake, lock, restart, or shut down PCs and Macs.

en-US.description: Remotely sleep, wake, lock, restart, or shut down PCs and Macs.
en-US.longDescription: Power Remote turns a phone, tablet, or another computer into a secure power remote for Windows PCs and Macs. Over a local network or Wi-Fi, it can sleep, wake, lock, restart, shut down, or log out a computer, turn its display off, or keep it awake with a timer.
en-US.name: Power Remote
